extension.summary: The Alamo - Sports, TV and Movies
extension.description: A clean, fast, poster-first video add-on with just three things: Sports, TV and Movies. Browsing is powered by TMDB, playback is powered by pluggable provider add-ons and ResolveURL. No clutter, no endless menus - just a beautiful wall of artwork.
extension.disclaimer: The Alamo does not host, provide or scrape any content by itself. All playable links come from provider plug-ins installed by the user.
extension.news: v1.0.2 - Titles on every grid tile, the focused home row now stays put while the rest fade back, and rows no longer scroll off screen.
